fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestShipCheck|TestShipMerge' passes with new tests where a fake gh reports isDraft true: ship check on a green draft PR exits 75 with a stop: line naming the PR as a draft and records no checked head; ship merge on a recorded head whose PR is now a draft exits 75 with that stop: line and never calls gh pr merge or gh pr ready; a ready PR still checks green and merges as before. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-merge-draft' passes: a ship-change run whose PR turns draft after sign-off stops at merge (not failed, no visit past 1 at gate-rebase-merge from merge), and after the fake PR is marked ready, rhiza run resume merges it. describe-golden is regenerated if a response type changes.
fields.statement: When a ship-change run's pull request is a draft, rhiza ship check and rhiza ship merge stop the run (exit 75) with a stop: line naming the PR as a draft to mark ready before resuming; they never report it green, never merge it, never mark it ready (no gh pr ready) and never fail merge into gate-rebase-merge, so the merge -> gate-rebase-merge loop cannot reach max_visits.
